game_intro_body: QR codes are placed around the building. Scan them with your phone's camera. Every code fills its own spot in the progress bar at the top, in any order.
game_intro_goal: Goal: find all the codes and collect your reward at the info desk.
game_completed_body: You found all the QR codes. Show this screen at the info desk to collect your reward.
ticket_body: Show this screen at the info desk to collect your reward.
ticket_proof: The ticking clock and moving logo show this screen is real, not a screenshot.
restart_body: Your progress and time will be erased, and your ticket disappears. So collect your reward at the info desk first!
footer_event: HU University of Applied Sciences Utrecht Open Day
qr_intro: Print this page and put up each poster at its location. Every code opens the scavenger hunt at the right step.
error_page_body: That's on us, not you. Your progress is safely stored on your phone.
not_found_body: Just like a well-hidden QR code. Only this one can't be found.
